Definition: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)
BiblicalUsage: A pendant for the ears is part of the spoil and part of the judgment. Gideon takes a thousand and seven hundred shekels of golden earrings from the Midianite kings, and Isaiah lists the chains and bracelets and earrings among the finery the daughters of Zion will lose.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the earrings tell both stories at once: the gold of victory and the gold of vanity, and the same ornament can be either.
